description.value: Records, on a type profile in a snapshot element, how much of what the profile says on its root element has been merged into the snapshot element. Snapshot generation merges the constraints on the root of a data type profile (cardinality, value ranges, fixed and pattern values, invariants, bindings, mappings, must-support and must-have-value) into the element that uses the profile, so the element carries them directly; this extension says whether that has been done fully, partially, or not at all, so that consumers such as validators know whether they still need to check the root of the type profile

short.value: Whether the root constraints of this type profile are merged into the snapshot element

definition.value: Whether the constraints this type profile makes on its root element have been merged into the snapshot element that uses the profile: fully, partially, or not at all. Only used in snapshots; set by the snapshot generator.

comment.value: Documentation (short, definition, comment etc.) on the root of a type profile is never merged, since it describes the type, not the element; that doesn't make the merge partial.

meaningWhenMissing.value: The snapshot was generated by a tool that doesn't record this, so it's unknown whether any constraints were merged: consumers should behave as if none were
